item.title: And the sticker winner is… — Central Vermont Community Radio
item.description: Voting on the sticker design is now closed as of 3/2/26. Thanks to the 40 folks who voted and all our designers. Congrats to Athena Siegel for winning with the cassette tape design! If you donate $53 or more during the upcoming fundrive, we’ll send you one in the mail.
